text_en: To the leader. Of the Korahites. A Psalm.
text_cn: 科辣黑后裔的诗歌，交与乐官。

text_en: Clap your hands, all you peoples; shout to God with loud songs of joy.
text_cn: 万民，你们要鼓掌欢腾， 也要向天主欢呼祝庆！

text_en: For the Lord , the Most High, is awesome, a great king over all the earth.
text_cn: 因上主至大至尊，可敬可畏， 他是统治宇宙的伟大君主。

text_en: He subdued peoples under us, and nations under our feet.
text_cn: 他镇压万民属我们管辖， 他屈服列邦在我们脚下。

text_en: He chose our heritage for us, the pride of Jacob whom he loves. Selah
text_cn: 他为我们选定了我们的基业， 即他所钟爱的雅各伯的光彩。 （休止）

text_en: God has gone up with a shout, the Lord with the sound of a trumpet.
text_cn: 天主上升，有欢呼声护送， 上主腾空，有号角声相从。

text_en: Sing praises to God, sing praises; sing praises to our King, sing praises.
text_cn: 你们应歌颂，歌颂我们的天主， 你们应歌颂，歌颂我们的君主。

text_en: For God is the king of all the earth; sing praises with a psalm.
text_cn: 因为天主是普世的君王， 你们都应该以诗歌赞扬。

text_en: God is king over the nations; God sits on his holy throne.
text_cn: 天主作王统治万国， 天主登上圣座宝位。

text_en: The princes of the peoples gather as the people of the God of Abraham. For the shields of the earth belong to God; he is highly exalted.
text_cn: 万民的王侯聚集起来，要作亚巴郎天主的子民； 因为大地的权贵，尽属于天主，唯天主至高至尊。
